Free shipping on 2+ items. Cash on delivery available.

London fragrance. Filipino spirit.

Our mission is to bring carefully curated fragrances from London to the Philippines, creating scents that complement Filipino tastes, lifestyle and the tropical environment.

Make your scent journey personal. Explore the collection and tap Order Now. #DearBodyPH #AScentJourney

title: Find what feels like you
objective: Make fragrance discovery feel personal using the existing wearer-personality descriptions, while inviting exploration of all six priority scents.
casting: One adult Filipino woman's hand beside white-label Mojito; one adult Filipino man's hand beside black-label Oud. No faces, heads or partial faces.
description: Mojito Metallique: friendly, easygoing, lighthearted. Oud Mirage: independent, reflective, self-assured. These are brand personality interpretations, not measurable effects of wearing a fragrance.
scene: Two personal-style arrangements share a burnt-orange tabletop. Left: Mojito, yellow ribbing, red pouch and cream headphones. Right: Oud, burgundy journal, cobalt strap and cream tray. The side-by-side styling gives a visual choice without labeling one personality better.
styling: Her coral nails and warm yellow accents; his natural nails and burgundy/cream accents. Warm orange dominates the frame; blue is limited to Oud and the bag strap.
props: Exact Mojito and Oud bottles, two small personal-style sets, cream tray. The notebook stays closed; no quizzes or fictional personality-test results appear on screens.
lighting: Sunlit editorial light with fill across both labels so one side is not visually privileged. Keep both bottles equally sharp and similarly sized.
camera: Three-quarter overhead view, locked two-product master with separate product inserts. Keep both hand positions low enough to preserve the labels.
performance: Let the woman's fingertips rest near Mojito's base and the man's hand settle on the tray beside Oud. Small gestures establish ownership; avoid presenting a forced choice or a claim about the viewer.
sound: Licensed light groove; use a headphone tap for the left vignette and a soft journal set-down for the right, balanced in level.
